 What we know about an expanded Clemson central front office, GM, roster management and additional staffing
 Larry_Williams @ LarryWilliamsTI 11/11/26 13 Share Share Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect Over the last 24 hours Tigerillustrated.com has spoken with multiple sources on an expanded Clemson central front office. In the vital areas of valuation and evaluation, there will be more levers to the process. And we are told they will not all be under Dabo Swinney's watch. We have much more here.
